message0: Grow tree from %1 at x %2 y %3 z %4 max bonemeal attempts %5
tooltip: Places the given sapling/tree item at the given position (server-side only) and repeatedly applies real bonemeal growth logic until it becomes a full tree or the attempt limit is reached. Dark oak and pale oak are planted as a 2x2 group automatically, since vanilla only grows those from a 2x2 sapling arrangement. Returns true if it grew into a tree. Intended for dev-time structure capture, not gameplay.
